description.value: Il Greco is a Greek and pizza restaurant located in Victoria's Gorge neighbourhood, operating as a takeout and delivery focused spot. With a gmail contact address and a compact unit-suite location, it has the feel of a neighbourhood quick-service restaurant rather than a sit-down destination. Cyclists passing through the Gorge Road corridor could use it as a pickup stop, though amenity details beyond takeout are unverified.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 19m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ilgrecos.com has been hijacked and redirects to an Indonesian gambling app (TUMI123), providing zero usable information about Il Greco restaurant. All amenity answers are therefore derived from OSM tags alone: takeaway=yes confirms takeout, outdoor_seating=no confirms no patio. The website mismatch is flagged as a concern and contact_confirmed.website is set to false.
concerns: Website domain ilgrecos.com has been hijacked and now serves content for an Indonesian gambling/gaming app (TUMI123) — completely unrelated to the restaurant. No usable website evidence available.
outdoor_seating=no per OSM — limited cyclist-friendly seating.
Unit 102 of a multi-unit building on Gorge Road West — may have limited street frontage or bike parking access.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business appears to be a legitimate active restaurant per OSM (check_date 2025-09-21, looks_closed=false), but its listed website has been hijacked by an unrelated Indonesian gambling app, making it impossible to verify any amenity claims or contact details. The domain issue should be resolved and the listing re-evaluated before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email (ilgrecopizza@gmail.com) from OSM is a personal Gmail address consistent with a small owner-operated business. The operator should be contacted to update or reclaim their website domain.
